title: Bhalobasi Tomake
desc: With a temper that's always on the verge of boiling over, a young man's life is transformed in an instant when he meets a woman who brings out the best in him.

title: Aasroy
desc: Ankhu, after losing his wife, decides to marry another girl for the sake of his son, Sudhanshu. But things take a turn when Sudhanshu falls in love with Joysree, who is an orphan.

title: Ei Ghar Ei Sansar
desc: After their parents' demise, a woman puts her life on hold to tend to her brothers, but later experiences hardships and betrayals from backstabbing her family.

title: Annaye Atyachar
desc: An inebriated Udayan spends a night with his friend's daughter, Kunti, mistaking her to be his wife. He leaves unaware the next morning, setting off a chain of chaotic events.

title: Mahaguru
desc: Rudra Sen, a brave officer and an encounter specialist, is killed in the line of duty by a gangster. However, things become complicated when his doppelganger decides to take his place and avenge him.
